observations: A broad sweep of golden yellow fills the right half and lower left, built from dense overlapping black scribble lines layered over the flat color beneath.
A narrow blue-white zigzag band cuts diagonally from upper left toward lower center, flanked on both sides by the yellow mass.
A compact green form sits near the center, outlined in dark green with lighter green scribble fill, rising against the yellow and meeting the blue band at its base.
reading: Golden yellow dominates, broken by a winding blue channel and a green form at the image's center. Black scribble lines layered over the flat yellow give that area a restless, almost vibrating surface, while the blue strip reads as cooler and more still by contrast. The green form sits where the two other colors meet — a point of tension rather than resolution.
